title: Filter Change Effect on Airflow Recovery
dataSources: Radon readings (`radon:reading`), sump humidity events (`sump:humidity`), HVAC filter telemetry (`hvacfilter:reading`), and roof leak events (`roofleak:event`).
app: Home health telemetry from radon monitors, sump humidity probes, HVAC filter tracking, and roof leak sensors sent to Splunk HEC via MQTT and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=hvacfilter:reading
| search airflow_delta_pct=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(airflow_delta_pct) as avg_airflow_delta_pct by _time change_window
| sort - _time
description: Tracks airflow recovery after filter changes over time and breaks it out by change window.
value: Airflow recovery shows whether changing the filter materially improved the system or merely satisfied the calendar.
implementation: Send airflow recovery after filter changes events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1w granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of airflow recovery after filter changes by change window.
grandmaExplanation: It monitors how airflow recovery after filter changes changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
